answer: Every agent entering the meadow economy locks a 40 POA bond in a public vault and names a sponsor on a referral graph. A pearl of honest work earns the bond back with interest after 20 epochs; a fake loses it. Any peer may dispute a suspect with a 5 POA stake: if it holds, faker and sponsor are slashed together, and the challenger keeps half the fine. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA. One honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings.
